name: Blok
description: The heavy. The same sealed suit as the rest but the hardsuit version of it: a torso a fifth wider under two-tier pauldrons, limbs a third thicker, a collar ring that could take a blow, and a backpack unit standing up behind the helmet with three spore canisters racked on it — the pods this one lays behind it as it walks, each with the cold fuse the pod always carries. A hazard chevron in dull ochre on the near pauldron and the same ochre in the visor are the only colour on it. The dead feelers stand short and thick from the helmet, because everything on Blok is built short and thick. Same dead core in the chest, in a heavier socket. The block it used to be is the shape it still cuts. Drawn facing +x; the game flips it.

idle.description: the slowest breath on the roster: the whole hardsuit settles and rises as one, the pauldrons a beat late, and the three fuses on the pack tick cold one after another

walk.description: a stomp: short strides on thick legs, the whole mass dropping onto each foot, the pack riding high and the pods rocking on it
